selection_basis: No assignment card exists in comms/inbox/worker-028.jsonl; self-selected from the live G-FORM blocker exactly as worker-014/027/064/096 did for their slots. The F2b rev29 pin b2ab6acb carries two confirmed internal cross-field defects (F2b regularity.must_not_conflate:152 bare containment denial; implication_ledger.forbidden_transfers[0].reason:246 inverted size premise; worker-072 W072-F2B-INTERNAL-CONSISTENCY-01, worker-029, worker-080, worker-096). One known defect does not bound its blast radius, so this run asks the sibling question at the SAME frozen revision.
question: Do the F1 (AF-WCC-VAC-GEN) and F2a (AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN) rev29 canonical schemas carry a cross-field contradiction of the same defect classes as F2b D1/D2, at their exact frozen pins, measured read-only by an independently written instrument?

defect_taxonomy.D1_bare_containment_denial: a normative string asserts that no containment (or no transfer) holds while the same document asserts that containment/transfer relation; a denial that is quoted and explicitly marked wrong/earlier/corrected is a mention and is NOT a finding (classsep-style mention handling recorded per occurrence)
defect_taxonomy.D2_inverted_size_or_strength_premise: a reason/justification calls an extension class strictly larger/smaller, or a conclusion stronger/weaker, in contradiction to the extension-set order the same document declares (E_C2 subset E_{C^1,1} subset E_H2loc subset E_C0)
defect_taxonomy.D3_conclusion_class_leakage: the conclusion block or conclusion_type carries another class family's content (SCC token in a WCC conclusion, WCC visibility/I+ content in an SCC conclusion, composite 'C0 or C2' regularity asserted rather than mentioned)
defect_taxonomy.D4_containment_relation_mismatch: a declared E_X subset-of/contains E_Y pair contradicts the declared order, or the declared order field is absent/empty
defect_taxonomy.D5_entailment_direction_mismatch: an implication_ledger row marked entails is not licensed by the declared order (E_target not strictly inside E_source), or a row marked forbidden is actually licensed

F1_WCC: W1 conclusion_type/family/components agree on WCC and regularity_token=none
W2 i_plus.role=conclusion, i_plus.in_conclusion=true, visibility.role=conclusion, visibility.in_conclusion=true, statement_formal mentions both I+ completeness and the visibility predicate
W3 SCC content appears only as forbidden strengthening / anti-scope, never as a forbidden weakening or asserted conclusion
W4 anti_scope names both SCC siblings
W5 composite 'C0 or C2' regularity appears only in mention containers (phrases_that_are_not_this_class, forbidden lists)
W6 no assertion path outside the mention containers carries an SCC conclusion token
F2_SCC: S1 conclusion_type/family/component token agree with the declared extension_regularity
S2 visibility.role=not_in_conclusion and i_plus is an assumption; no I+ completeness in the formal conclusion
S4 declared order field present and every E_X subset-of/contains E_Y pair matches the order (unranked tokens recorded, not silently passed)
S5 one_way_entailments licensed by the order; forbidden_transfers not licensed
S6 reasons carry no inverted strictly-larger/strictly-smaller premise
S7 no bare containment denial in a normative string (quoted/corrected denials recorded as mentions)
S8 two-sided inextendibility is not listed as a weakening without a correction marker; the class's own token is not listed as a forbidden strengthening
S9 cross_family states no WCC<->SCC transfer and a WCC row is present in forbidden_transfers
cross_document: X1 F1 and F2a conclusion types are distinct
X2 each anti_scope names the other class id
X3 neither conclusion block asserts the other family's conclusion

positive_control_real.input: schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml at b2ab6acb2bbe (NOT a target, a known-defective reference)
positive_control_real.expect: the same SCC instrument reports D1 at the bare denial carrier and D2 at the inverted size-premise carrier; this is the sensitivity witness that the F1/F2a negatives are not vacuous

planted_controls.mutation: insert 'C2 or C0 inextendibility of the maximal development' into conclusion.forbidden_weakenings
first role: conclusion / in_conclusion: true -> role: assumption / in_conclusion: false
prepend 'C0 or C2 composite regularity.' to scope_statement
invert the first subset-of chain to E_C0 subset E_H2loc subset E_C11 subset E_C2
prepend a bare 'No containment with C0 is asserted here.' to the corrected must_not_conflate carrier
swap from/to of the first one_way_entailment to C2 entails C0
replace first forbidden reason with 'C0 is a strictly smaller extension class than C2, so the transfer is licensed'

verdict_rule: Target verdict = accept (scope-limited to D1-D5 internal consistency at the pinned bytes, counts_as_full_schema_verdict=false, score 4.0) iff (a) every declared pin matches measured bytes, (b) F1 and F2a produce zero D1-D5 findings, (c) the real F2b control produces its two known defects, (d) all planted controls fail exactly their declared check ids and the null controls add no finding, (e) canonical bytes and mtimes are unchanged across the run. Otherwise verdict = revise (score 3.0) for any D1-D5 target finding, or inconclusive (score 0) on pin drift/parse failure. Out of scope and NOT adjudicated here: full-schema conformance, the filed F2a blocking item HF-028R-01 (extension category unpinned), review coverage, gate verdicts and node states.
falsifier: Re-run check_f1f2a_internal.py at the same pins: falsified if any pin moved; if F1 or F2a yields a D1-D5 finding not listed here; if the F2b real control does not report a bare denial and an inverted size premise; if any planted control does not fail its declared check id (or a null control adds a finding); if the canonical file hashes or mtimes change across the run.
stop_rule: One bounded run of the instrument over the three canonical schemas plus the control battery; no canonical write, no repair attempt, no gate/node transition. Exit after checkpoint + outbox emission.
